content: + News (End-to-End W-L Att Sentence Encoder) + NRA: The Word-Level Attention (W-L Att) sentence encoder implements an attention mechanism directly on top of word embeddings, and, as such, does not consider the order of words in a sentence. This baseline complements the previous one, i.e. it evaluates the influence of the sentence encoder when our full specification is considered.
